complexity.notes: Compared to the previous version, this copies cost directly so the last two entries are already correct and the base-case assignments are dropped — a nice tidy-up. Space can be reduced from O(n) to O(1) since ||only the last two computed values are ever needed, so two rolling variables suffice instead of the full array||.
complexity.summary: Bottom-up DP walking backwards: a[i] is the min cost to reach the top from index i, computed as cost[i] plus the cheaper of the next two entries; the answer is min(a[0], a[1]).
